commands.command:
sudo mkdir -p /srv/data
cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-mount.sh > /dev/null
#!/bin/sh
set -e
IMG=/var/lib/srvdata-backing/disk0.img
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup -f --show "$IMG")
fi
vgchange -ay vg_srv
mountpoint -q /srv/data || mount /dev/vg_srv/lv_data /srv/data
EOF
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-mount.sh
cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data.service > /dev/null
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed LVM volume group and mount /srv/data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=local-fs-pre.target systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs.target
Requires=systemd-udev-settle.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-mount.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable srv-data.service && sudo systemctl start srv-data.service && echo DONE
systemctl is-active srv-data.service; df -hT /srv/data; mount | grep srv/data
